title: State of Claim Maintenance — report #1

derived_from.rule: every field below is read from those exact bytes. Nothing is derived, interpolated or estimated.

what_this_is: a dated reading of the claim-maintenance register, published so the register's own state can be read without running the register and without trusting this page.
what_this_is_not: not a certification, a rank, a grade or a score
not a statement that the claim-maintenance axis is MEASURED - the axis carries its own status, and this report neither moves it nor pre-empts the decision that moves it
not a claim that any individual captured claim is true; it reports how many claims the register holds and in which states the register places them
not a measurement of any model, system or vendor
states_are_the_register_s_own: CLAIM_CAPTURED, CLAIM_MEASURED, UNMEASURED and UNCHECKABLE are the register's own vocabulary. UNMEASURED is a declared position with no run behind it. UNCHECKABLE is a cell the method could not settle. Neither is a zero, and a refusal is never converted to a zero.

correction_carried_here.what_was_published: a 30 September working note recorded "subjects with scheduled next read: 26" and "scheduled subject coverage: 92.86%" (26 of 28 subjects), derived from the register version then live.
correction_carried_here.state: the 92.86% coverage figure is superseded by this reading. The note received a dated correction on 2026-10-30; a dated record is not rewritten and the error is kept visible.
correction_carried_here.note_location: _alignment/CLAIM-MAINTENANCE-CATEGORY-CONVERGENCE-20260930.md (a working document, not a published estate page)

not_a_certification: This report counts rows in a register. It decides nothing about whether any measured claim is true, and it grants no status to any subject.
